ItemLevelMin_Shield.label: Shield Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Shield.description: Min level for shields. Suggest 5 under max for upgrades (Default: varies)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Gem.label: Min Level: Gem
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Gem.description: Force dropped gems to a minimum level (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Gem.label: Gem Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Gem.description: Min level for dropped gems (Default: varies)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Ring.label: Min Level: Ring
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Ring.description: Force dropped rings to a minimum level. Suggest 5 levels under max for in-game upgrades (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Ring.label: Ring Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Ring.description: Min level for rings. Suggest 5 under max for upgrades (Default: varies)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Spell.label: Min Level: Spell
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Spell.description: Force dropped spells to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Arrow.label: Min Level: Arrow
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Arrow.description: Force dropped arrows to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Tool.label: Min Level: Tool
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Tool.description: Force dropped tools to a minimum level (Default: false)

Enable_ItemLevelMin_Misc.label: Min Level: Misc
Enable_ItemLevelMin_Misc.description: Force other leveled items to a minimum level (Default: false)

ItemLevelMin_Misc.label: Misc Min Level
ItemLevelMin_Misc.description: Min level for miscellaneous items (Default: varies)

Enable_AttributeScaling.label: Attribute Scaling
Enable_AttributeScaling.description: Master switch for Attribute Scaling changes (Default: false)

Enable_PlayerBaseStats.label: Player Base Stats
Enable_PlayerBaseStats.description: Master switch for base player stats (Default: false)

PlayerFog_PerFlameLevel.label: Shroud Time per Flame
PlayerFog_PerFlameLevel.description: Extra shroud time per flame level in seconds (Default: 60)

Enable_DamageTweaks.label: Weapon Damage Multipliers
Enable_DamageTweaks.description: Master switch for player damage multipliers (Default: false)

Enable_ToolTweaks.label: Tool Damage Multipliers
Enable_ToolTweaks.description: Master switch for tool damage multipliers (Default: false)

ToolMult_Axe.label: Axe Multiplier
ToolMult_Axe.description: Multiplies Wood damage specifically for Axes (Default: 1.0)

ToolMult_Pickaxe.label: Pickaxe Multiplier
ToolMult_Pickaxe.description: Multiplies Stone/Terrain damage specifically for Pickaxes (Default: 1.0)

Enable_SpellTweaks.label: Spell Tweaks
Enable_SpellTweaks.description: Master switch for spell casting adjustments (Default: false)

SpellCastTime_Multiplier.label: Spell Cast Time Multiplier
SpellCastTime_Multiplier.description: Multiplies spell cast time, lower is faster (Default: 1.0) (enter decimal, e.g. 0.03)

RegenMult_Health.label: Health Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Health.description: Multiplies health regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

RegenMult_Mana.label: Mana Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Mana.description: Multiplies mana regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

RegenMult_Stamina.label: Stamina Regen Multiplier
RegenMult_Stamina.description: Multiplies stamina regeneration rate from gear (Default: 1.0)

SpellManaCost_Multiplier.label: Spell Mana Cost Multiplier
SpellManaCost_Multiplier.description: Multiplies spell mana cost, lower is cheaper (Default: 1.0) (enter decimal, e.g. 0.03)

Enable_BackpackTweaks.label: Backpack Tweaks
Enable_BackpackTweaks.description: Master switch for overriding backpack slot sizes (Default: false)

Backpack_MaxSlots.label: Backpack Max Slots
Backpack_MaxSlots.description: Max slots for the backpack (Default: Varies by backpack)

Enable_StackSizeTweaks.label: Stack Size Tweaks
Enable_StackSizeTweaks.description: Master switch for overriding max stack limits (Default: false)

StackSize_MaxStack.label: Max Stack Size
StackSize_MaxStack.description: Maximum possible item stack size across the board (Default: Varies by item)

Enable_ChestSizeTweaks.label: Chest Size Tweaks
Enable_ChestSizeTweaks.description: Master switch for overriding chest storage capacity (Default: false)

Chest_MaxSlots.label: Chest Max Slots
Chest_MaxSlots.description: Max slots for storage chests and factories (Default: Varies by chest)

Enable_MagicFurniture.label: Magic Furniture
Enable_MagicFurniture.description: Enables magic storage on standard decorative furniture (Default: false)

Enable_MagicFactories.label: Magic Factories
Enable_MagicFactories.description: Enables magic storage on production buildings (Default: false)

Enable_LootTweaks.label: Loot Drop Multipliers
Enable_LootTweaks.description: Master switch for loot drop multipliers (Default: false)

Loot_EquipmentDropMultiplier.label: Equipment Drop Multiplier
Loot_EquipmentDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for duplicate weapons, armor, and shields. Base range varies (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ConsumableDropMultiplier.label: Consumable Drop Multiplier
Loot_ConsumableDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for potions, spells, and food. Base range varies (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ArrowDropMultiplier.label: Arrow Drop Multiplier
Loot_ArrowDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for arrows and ammo. Base range varies (Default: 1.0)

Loot_GemDropMultiplier.label: Gem Drop Multiplier
Loot_GemDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for socketable gems. Base range varies (Default: 1.0)

Loot_ExplosiveDropMultiplier.label: Explosive Drop Multiplier
Loot_ExplosiveDropMultiplier.description: Multiplier for grenades and explosives. Base range varies (e.g. 2-4) (Default: 1.0)

Loot_MaxStackSize.label: Loot Max Stack
Loot_MaxStackSize.description: Max stack size that can appear directly in loot tables (Default: 65535)

Enable_GemTweaks.label: Gem Tweaks
Enable_GemTweaks.description: Master switch for gem probability and salvage tweaks (Default: false)

GemTweaks_SalvageRate.label: Gem Salvage Rate
GemTweaks_SalvageRate.description: Ratio of material returned when salvaging gems (Default: 0.5)

GemTweaks_Probability_Common.label: Gem Prob (Common)
GemTweaks_Probability_Common.description: Probability of a gem slot on common rarity items (Default: 0.0)

GemTweaks_Probability_Uncommon.label: Gem Prob (Uncommon)
GemTweaks_Probability_Uncommon.description: Probability of a gem slot on uncommon rarity items (Default: 0.05)

GemTweaks_Probability_Rare.label: Gem Prob (Rare)
GemTweaks_Probability_Rare.description: Probability of a gem slot on rare rarity items (Default: 0.25)

GemTweaks_Probability_Epic.label: Gem Prob (Epic)
GemTweaks_Probability_Epic.description: Probability of a gem slot on epic rarity items (Default: 0.5)

GemTweaks_Probability_Legendary.label: Gem Prob (Legendary)
GemTweaks_Probability_Legendary.description: Probability of a gem slot on legendary rarity items (Default: 1.0)

Enable_CraftingTweaks.label: Crafting Tweaks
Enable_CraftingTweaks.description: Master switch for crafting modifications (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_UnlockAllRecipes.label: Unlock All Recipes
CraftingTweaks_UnlockAllRecipes.description: Temporarily unlocks all crafting recipes without requiring discovery (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_CreativeMode.label: Creative Mode
CraftingTweaks_CreativeMode.description: Removes crafting material costs completely, making crafts free (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFactories.label: Free Factories
CraftingTweaks_FreeFactories.description: Makes factory recipes free, independent of Creative Mode (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_OutputMultiplier.label: Crafting Output Multiplier
CraftingTweaks_OutputMultiplier.description: Increases crafted quantity yield, 2.0 = double output (Default: 1.0)

Enable_FastTravelTweaks.label: Fast Travel Tweaks
Enable_FastTravelTweaks.description: Master switch for adding fast travel points (Default: false)

FastTravel_FlameMarkers.label: Flame Markers
FastTravel_FlameMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Flame Sanctums and Shrines (Default: false)

FastTravel_DungeonMarkers.label: Dungeon Markers
FastTravel_DungeonMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Dungeons and Hollow Halls (Default: false)

FastTravel_LocationMarkers.label: Location Markers
FastTravel_LocationMarkers.description: Enable fast travel to Towns, Mines, and Farms (Default: false)

FastTravel_None.label: Quest Markers
FastTravel_None.description: Enable fast travel to discovered Quest markers (Default: false)

Enable_FogOfWarTweaks.label: Fog of War Tweaks
Enable_FogOfWarTweaks.description: Master switch for map discovery range (Default: false)

FogOfWar_Range.label: Fog of War Range
FogOfWar_Range.description: Fog of war clearing radius on the map (Default: 300)

Enable_SkillTweaks_Updraft.label: Updraft Tweaks
Enable_SkillTweaks_Updraft.description: Master switch for updraft skill edits (Default: false)

Updraft_IgnoreManaCost.label: Ignore Updraft Mana Cost
Updraft_IgnoreManaCost.description: Disable Updraft mana cost completely (Default: false)

Enable_SlopeTweaks.label: Slope Tweaks
Enable_SlopeTweaks.description: Master switch for slope climbing and sliding angles (Default: false)

steepFloorAngle.label: Steep Floor Angle
steepFloorAngle.description: Angle at which terrain becomes difficult to walk up (Default: 45.0)

slidingAngle.label: Sliding Angle
slidingAngle.description: Angle at which you start sliding off terrain (Default: 55.0)

fallDamageAngle.label: Fall Damage Angle
fallDamageAngle.description: Angle at which fall damage calculation triggers when sliding (Default: 65.0)

Enable_FlameAltarTweaks.label: Flame Altar Tweaks
Enable_FlameAltarTweaks.description: Master switch for flame altar capacity limits (Default: false)

MaxFlameAltars_Multiplier.label: Flame Altar Multiplier
MaxFlameAltars_Multiplier.description: Multiplies buildable Flame Altars per flame level (Default: 1.0)

MaxFlameAltars_Cap.label: Flame Altar Cap
MaxFlameAltars_Cap.description: Hard cap for maximum Flame Altars possible (Default: 16)

Enable_BaseSizeTweaks.label: Base Size Tweaks
Enable_BaseSizeTweaks.description: Master switch for build zone boundaries (Default: false)

BaseSize_Multiplier.label: Base Size Multiplier
BaseSize_Multiplier.description: Multiplies X, Y, Z dimensions of Flame Altar build zones (Default: 1.0)

Enable_PlacementTweaks.label: Placement Tweaks
Enable_PlacementTweaks.description: Master switch for building placement rules (Default: false)

Enable_BuildingTweaks.label: Remove No-Build Zones
Enable_BuildingTweaks.description: Removes all "No Build Zones" from the game world (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_BuildInFog.label: Build in Fog
PlacementTweaks_BuildInFog.description: Allows building placement directly inside Shroud fog (Default: false)

PlacementTweaks_NoBuildZoneNeeded.label: No Build Zone Needed
PlacementTweaks_NoBuildZoneNeeded.description: Allows placement anywhere outside Flame Altar zones (Default: false)

Enable_FogTweaks.label: Fog & Weather Tweaks
Enable_FogTweaks.description: Master switch for fog visual density edits (Default: false)

HeightFog_Density.label: Height Fog Density
HeightFog_Density.description: Fog density when looking down from high altitude (Default: 0.0012)

HeightFog_Opacity.label: Height Fog Opacity
HeightFog_Opacity.description: Light penetration when looking down from high altitude (Default: 0.15)

Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Exposed_Emissive_I.label: Blue Barrier Exposed
Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Exposed_Emissive_I.description: Brightness of outer edge of blue shroud (Default: 0.1)

Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Emissive_Intensity.label: Blue Barrier Emissive
Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Emissive_Intensity.description: Brightness of inner edge of blue shroud (Default: 0.0)

Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Opacity.label: Blue Barrier Opacity
Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Opacity.description: Light penetration at blue shroud edge (Default: 0.3)

Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Scatter_Boost.label: Blue Barrier Scatter
Dangerous_Fog_Barrier_Scatter_Boost.description: Light diffusion at blue shroud edge (Default: 2.0)

Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Exposed_Emissive_Inte.label: Red Barrier Exposed
Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Exposed_Emissive_Inte.description: Brightness of outer edge of red shroud (Default: 0.2)

Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Emissive_Intensity.label: Red Barrier Emissive
Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Emissive_Intensity.description: Brightness of inner edge of red shroud (Default: 0.0)

Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Opacity.label: Red Barrier Opacity
Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Opacity.description: Light penetration at red shroud edge (Default: 0.5)

Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Scatter_Boost.label: Red Barrier Scatter
Deadly_Fog_Barrier_Scatter_Boost.description: Light diffusion at red shroud edge (Default: 2.0)

Enable_GliderTuning.label: Glider Tuning
Enable_GliderTuning.description: Master switch for tuning glider physics (Default: false)

MakeUnbreakableBreakable.label: Make Unbreakable Materials Breakable
MakeUnbreakableBreakable.description: Changes Unbreakable terrain materials to Hard so they can be broken (Default: false)

Enable_TerrainDropTweaks.label: Terrain Drop Tweaks
Enable_TerrainDropTweaks.description: Enables terrain item drop modification per voxel (Default: false)

TerrainDrop_ExchangeRate.label: Terrain Drop Rate
TerrainDrop_ExchangeRate.description: 1.0 = Full drop rate per voxel. 0.5 = half drop rate. Max 1.0 (Default: 0.2)

Enable_ExpandedGameSettings.label: Expanded Difficulty Sliders
Enable_ExpandedGameSettings.description: Master switch for detailed difficulty sliders (Default: false)

PlayerRelative_X.label: Player Relative X
PlayerRelative_X.description: Right/Left thrust relative to player yaw/roll (Default: nil)

PlayerRelative_Y.label: Player Relative Y
PlayerRelative_Y.description: Up/Down thrust relative to player pitch/yaw (Default: 0)

PlayerRelative_Z.label: Player Relative Z
PlayerRelative_Z.description: Forward/Backward thrust relative to player pitch/yaw (Default: nil)

Boost_Duration.label: Boost Duration
Boost_Duration.description: Duration of the updraft boost in seconds (Default: 2.25)

Updraft_ManaCost_Value.label: Updraft Mana Cost
Updraft_ManaCost_Value.description: Manually override Updraft mana cost value (Default: nil)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFlameAltar.label: Free Flame Altar Upgrades
CraftingTweaks_FreeFlameAltar.description: Makes Flame Altar upgrades free, independent of Creative Mode (Default: false)

CraftingTweaks_FreeFood.label: Free Food Crafting
CraftingTweaks_FreeFood.description: Makes food and fish recipes free, independent of Creative Mode (Default: false)

Enable_GearStatTweaks.label: Gear Stat Tweaks
Enable_GearStatTweaks.description: Master toggle for gear stat multipliers (Default: false)

GearMult_HealthBonus.label: Health Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_HealthBonus.description: Multiplier for health bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)

GearMult_StaminaBonus.label: Stamina Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_StaminaBonus.description: Multiplier for stamina bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)

GearMult_ManaBonus.label: Mana Bonus Multiplier
GearMult_ManaBonus.description: Multiplier for mana bonuses on gear (Default: 1.0)
